comment.text: PTPRD S431 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Lung tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting PTPRD residue S431 have been observed in uterine tumors, skin tumors, and bowel tumors.
